title: 001‘周年礼物’
slug: 年少情深被辜负他跪了我不要了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林萧这辈子收过最‘贵重’的结婚周年礼物，就是绿帽子。

送完之后，她还被这个男人‘请’出了宴会现场。

凌晨十二点，她抹着眼泪，穿着不合脚的鞋，在黑漆漆的雨夜里，深一脚浅一脚地往前走。

太晚了，加上暴雨，根本没车。

就在她抱着胳膊哆嗦时，手机响了。

屏幕上跳出来的名字，让她浑身一颤。

李铭烨。

“林萧，说了多少遍了，我只是陪冉冉过个生日而已，难道你就这么不信任我？”

林萧咬紧下唇，雨水顺着睫毛淌下来。

“信任？铭烨，我...”

话音未落，就被李铭烨不耐烦的打断。

“好了，晚点我回来再跟你解释，冉冉在喊我了。”

林萧本想说，今天下午是周冉冉给她发信息，说晚上西江别墅办宴会，让她打扮的漂亮点过来。

本以为是李铭烨精心准备的三周年宴会，没想到，这是周冉冉十九岁的生日宴会。

李铭烨为她请了半个城有头有脸的人过来。

“等等，李铭烨，你实话告诉我，是不是不爱我了？”

电话那头顿了一瞬。

紧接着，是李铭烨压着嗓子却压不住火的声音。

“行，又来了是吧？林萧，我当初为了娶你，差点跟我爸妈断绝关系，难道这还不够爱你？”

“可你现在变了！”林萧几乎扯着嗓子喊出了这句话。

然而，得到的依旧是不耐烦的回应。

“林萧，难道你没变吗？看看你现在的样子，啧。我都懒得说你，看看人家冉冉，今年又拿了奖学金，我资助她这么多年，她变得越来越优秀了。”

这话像是毒液般，迅速侵蚀了林萧本就脆弱无比的心脏。

她忍不住捂着嘴，鼻腔里又酸又胀。

突然想起那年高中，下课铃一响，林萧总是第一个跑到篮球场，偷偷把矿泉水塞进李铭烨手里。

仲夏傍晚，李铭烨举起那瓶水，笑着对她喊：“林萧，我喜欢你！”

后来，两人彼此鼓励，双双考入本地最好的大学。

林萧是年年拿奖学金的优等生，还在国际上拿了不少奖。甚至在大四实习那年，全球五十强企业的HR，破例与她见面，邀请她入职。

但在那年，林萧为了对李铭烨那句‘嫁给你，当你的全职太太照顾你’的承诺，选择了拒绝HR。

可是，李家父母死活不同意两人在一起，还派人多次骚扰林萧，让她自己离开李铭烨。

得知真相后的李铭烨，直接跟家里断了关系，带林萧住进五百块的出租屋。

白天上班，晚上送外卖，养着抑郁到出不了门的她。

那时候林萧觉得，这个男人就是她少女时代的英雄，是不顾一切也要娶灰姑娘的王子。

再后来，李家父母实在是心疼儿子，闭着眼同意了这门婚事。

于是，李铭烨在全城烟火下跪地求婚。

巨型烟花炸开，夜空里亮着：萧萧，我爱你，嫁给我吧。

那几年的苦，是林萧心里最软的枷锁。

她总记得李铭烨为了自己众叛亲离，日夜奔波的样子，心里悄悄认定，这辈子欠他一份全力以赴的偏爱。

所以婚后哪怕公婆冷眼，旁人惋惜，林萧也心甘情愿收起所有锋芒。

她想着，等日子彻底安稳，李铭烨事业落地，再重新拾起自己的前途。

可万万没想到，一次次的退让换来的不是珍惜，而是李铭烨的理所当然与得寸进尺。

如今他又办了一场烟花会，女主角‘理所应当’换了人。

现在，林萧一个人穿着不合脚的鞋子，一瘸一拐地走在冷雨中时，身后的烟花还在绽放。

用李铭烨的话来讲，这是他对周冉冉优秀的奖励，绝不是爱情。

可林萧不信。

婚后这三年来，林萧履行了自己成为好妻子的诺言，上得厅堂下得厨房。

就连那些难以应对的豪门人情世故，也丝毫没有落下。

就连当初看不起林萧的公婆，也意外地对她多了几次笑脸。

当烟花再次炸开的瞬间，夜空明亮如白昼。

Page (1/3)

The most 'expensive' wedding anniversary gift Lin Xiao has ever received in his life is a cuckold.

After sending it off, she was 'invited' out of the banquet by this man.

At twelve o'clock in the morning, she wiped her tears, wore ill-fitting shoes, and walked forward in the dark and rainy night.

It was too late, and with the heavy rain, there was no car at all.

Just as she was trembling with her arms crossed, her phone rang.

The name that popped up on the screen made her tremble.

Li Mingye.

"Lin Xiao, how many times have I told you that I am just spending a birthday with Ran Ran. Do you really not trust me so much?"

Lin Xiao bit her lower lip, rainwater dripping down her eyelashes.

"Trust? Mingye, I..."

Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted impatiently by Li Mingye.

"Okay, I'll explain to you when I come back later, Ran Ran is calling me."

Lin Xiao originally wanted to say that it was Zhou Ranran who sent her a message this afternoon, saying that there would be a banquet at Xijiang Villa that evening and asked her to dress up and come over.

I thought it was the third anniversary party carefully prepared by Li Mingye, but unexpectedly, it was Zhou Ranran's nineteenth birthday party.

Li Mingye invited half of the city's reputable people to come over for her.

"Wait a minute, Li Mingye, tell me the truth, do you not love me anymore?"

The person on the other end of the phone paused for a moment.

Immediately afterwards, Li Mingye pressed his throat but couldn't suppress the angry voice.

"Okay, here we go again, right? Lin Xiao, I almost broke off the relationship with my parents in order to marry you. Isn't that enough to love you?"

"But you have changed now!" Lin Xiao almost shouted this at the top of his lungs.

However, what I got was still an impatient response.

"Lin Xiao, haven't you changed? Look at how you look now, tsk. I'm too lazy to talk about you. Look at Ran Ran. She got a scholarship again this year. I've supported her for so many years, and she's getting better and better."

These words were like venom, quickly eroding Lin Xiao's fragile heart.

She couldn't help but cover her mouth, her nose was sore and swollen.

Suddenly I remembered that in high school, when the bell rang after class, Lin Xiao was always the first to run to the basketball court and secretly put mineral water into Li Mingye's hand.

In the midsummer evening, Li Mingye raised the bottle of water and shouted to her with a smile: "Lin Xiao, I like you!"

Later, the two encouraged each other and both were admitted to the best local universities.

Lin Xiao is a top student who receives scholarships every year and has also won many international awards.Even during her senior year of internship, HR from a Fortune 50 company made an exception to meet with her and invited her to join her.

But that year, Lin Xiao chose to reject HR in order to fulfill Li Mingye's promise of 'marry you and be your full-time wife to take care of you'.

However, the Li family's parents did not agree to the two being together, and sent people to harass Lin Xiao many times, asking her to leave Li Mingye on her own.

After learning the truth, Li Mingye immediately severed ties with his family and took Lin Xiao to live in a rental house worth 500 yuan.

She works during the day and delivers food at night, raising her to the point where she is too depressed to go out.

At that time, Lin Xiao felt that this man was the hero of her girlhood, the prince who wanted to marry Cinderella at all costs.

Later, the Li family's parents felt really sorry for their son and agreed to the marriage with their eyes closed.

So, Li Mingye knelt down and proposed under the city's fireworks.

Giant fireworks exploded and lit up the night sky: Xiao Xiao, I love you, marry me.

The hardships of those years were the softest shackles in Lin Xiao's heart.

She always remembered the way Li Mingye betrayed everyone and ran around day and night for her, and she secretly decided in her heart that she owed him a favor that would go all out for her in this life.

So after marriage, even if his parents-in-law looked coldly and others felt sorry for him, Lin Xiao was willing to put away all his sharpness.

She thought that when life was completely stable and Li Mingye's career was established, she could pick up her own future again.

But he never expected that what he gave in again and again was not cherishment, but Li Mingye's taking it for granted and taking advantage of it.

Now he held another fireworks show, and the heroine was changed as a matter of course.

Now, as Lin Xiao was limping alone in the cold rain wearing ill-fitting shoes, the fireworks behind him were still blooming.

In Li Mingye's words, this is his reward for Zhou Ranran's excellence, and it is definitely not love.

But Lin Xiao didn’t believe it.

In the past three years since their marriage, Lin Xiao has fulfilled her promise to be a good wife, both in the hall and in the kitchen.

Even the wealthy and sophisticated people who are difficult to deal with have not fallen behind at all.

Even her parents-in-law, who looked down on Lin Xiao at first, unexpectedly smiled at her several times.

When the fireworks exploded again, the night sky was as bright as day.
